products.name: PRINCE® FSR SAE 5W-40
facts: VHVI Group IV PAO + Group V Ester-Based 100% Synthetic Motor Oil
description: Expertly geared for the relentless demands of competitive environments, PRINCE® FSR SAE 5W-40 is a 100% synthetic motor oil formulated with a sophisticated blend of high-performance VHVI synthetic base oils, Group IV Polyalphaolefin (PAO) and Group V Double Ester (P-9/P-12) base stocks, fortified with cutting-edge racing-specific additive technology. The inherent polarity of its advanced ester components enhances lubricating film adhesion to metallic surfaces, while advanced boron-based additives and Zinc Dialkyldithiophosphate (ZDDP) anti-wear chemistry reinforce protection against extreme mechanical and thermal stress. Engineered to deliver exceptional shear stability, thermal and oxidative resistance, and robust high-temperature high-shear (HTHS) viscosity performance, its advanced formulation maintains consistent lubricating film integrity, minimises frictional losses and safeguards critical engine components during sustained high-RPM, high-load operation under challenging motorsport conditions.

Engineered to API SP performance standards, providing advanced LSPI suppression, improved protection against timing chain wear, and resistance to turbocharger oil coking and deposit-induced oil starvation.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Designed for highly stressed, high-revving and high-output naturally aspirated and turbocharged gasoline engines operating under extreme conditions. Well suited for demanding applications in both professional and amateur motorsport, including circuit racing, sprint racing, drag racing and time attack, as well as performance-oriented street driving where SAE 5W-40 viscosity is appropriate and recommended by the engine builder or tuning specialist.

facts: VHVI Group IV PAO + Group V Ester-Based 100% Synthetic Motor Oil
description: Developed to withstand the punishing demands of endurance racing and extreme competitive environments, PRINCE® FSR GT ENDURANCE SAE 10W-50 is a 100% synthetic motor oil formulated with a sophisticated blend of high-performance VHVI synthetic base oils, Group IV Polyalphaolefin (PAO) and Group V Double Ester (P-9/P-12) base stocks, reinforced with advanced racing-specific additive technology. products.name: PRINCE® FSR GT EXTREME SAE 10W-60
facts: VHVI Group IV PAO + Group V Ester-Based 100% Synthetic Motor Oil
description: Masterfully formulated to withstand exceptional thermal stress, intense shear forces and severe mechanical loads, PRINCE® FSR GT EXTREME SAE 10W-60 is a 100% synthetic motor oil developed with a sophisticated blend of high-performance VHVI synthetic Group IV Polyalphaolefin (PAO) and Group V Double Ester (P-9/P-12) base stocks, reinforced with unparalleled heavy-duty racing additive technology. Its exceptionally robust SAE 10W-60 viscosity profile delivers outstanding lubricating film strength and high-temperature high-shear (HTHS) viscosity performance under extreme cylinder pressures, elevated oil temperatures and severe bearing loads. Fortified with an advanced boron-based additive package and Zinc Dialkyldithiophosphate (ZDDP) anti-wear chemistry, its formulation is engineered to resist permanent viscosity loss, maintain stable oil pressure and safeguard critical engine components against accelerated wear and lubricating film breakdown under the most punishing motorsport environments.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Specially developed for extremely high-output, high-boost and purpose-built racing engines, including high-displacement and high-revving powertrains subjected to extreme thermal, shear forces and mechanical loads. Particularly suited to endurance racing, GT racing, circuit racing, drag racing, drift racing and other severe-duty motorsport applications, as well as selected high-performance European sport vehicles and competition engines with increased bearing clearances where SAE 10W-60 viscosity grade is specified by the vehicle manufacturer, as well as recommended by the engine builder or tuning specialist.

products.name: PRINCE® PRO-SHIFT GT RACING GL-5 SAE 75W-90
facts: API GL-5, API GL-5 +LS, API MT-1
description: Precision-formulated for the demanding drivetrain requirements of competitive motorsport, PRINCE® PRO-SHIFT GT RACING GL-5 SAE 75W-90 is a high-performance racing gear oil reinforced with advanced extreme-pressure (EP) additives and specialised limited-slip friction modifiers. Its shear-stable formulation delivers robust lubricating film strength under aggressive torque transfer, sudden shock loads and sustained high-speed gear operation, safeguarding critical gear teeth, bearings and hypoid gear assemblies against scuffing, pitting and premature wear. Engineered to optimise drivetrain efficiency, thermal stability and controlled limited-slip differential engagement, it provides consistent lubrication performance under demanding competitive conditions.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Specifically developed for high-torque and heavy-duty drivetrain assemblies in race-ready and high-performance sports vehicles, including hypoid drive axles, conventional differentials, limited-slip differentials (LSD), non-synchronised racing gearboxes and transaxles requiring SAE 75W-90 gear oil meeting GL-5 performance requirements.

products.name: PRINCE® PRO-SHIFT GT RACING GL-5 SAE 75W-140
facts: API GL-5, API GL-5 +LS, API MT-1
description: Developed to withstand extreme torque loads and severe thermal stress in competitive motorsport, PRINCE® PRO-SHIFT GT RACING GL-5 SAE 75W-140 is an advanced fully synthetic racing gear oil reinforced with a cutting-edge extreme-pressure (EP) additive package and specialized limited-slip friction modifiers. Its robust SAE 75W-140 viscosity profile delivers exceptional lubricating film strength under aggressive torque transfer, repeated shock loads and prolonged high-temperature operation, safeguarding heavily loaded hypoid gears and bearings against scuffing, pitting and adhesive wear. Its advanced shear-stable formulation is engineered to maintain viscosity integrity, controlled limited-slip differential engagement and consistent drivetrain protection under the most punishing competitive conditions.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Specifically developed for ultra-high-torque and severely loaded drivetrain assemblies in extensively modified, race-ready and high-performance sports vehicles, including heavy-duty hypoid drive axles, conventional and limited-slip differentials (LSD), non-synchronised racing gearboxes and transaxles requiring SAE 75W-140 gear oil meeting GL-5 performance requirements.

products.name: PRINCE® BRAKE FLUID GT RACING
facts: FMVSS 116 DOT 4, ISO 4925 Class 4, SAE J1704
description: PRINCE® BRAKE FLUID GT RACING is a high-performance glycol ether and borate ester-based brake fluid developed to withstand the extreme thermal demands of competitive motorsport. Featuring an exceptionally high dry boiling point exceeding 320°C and a wet boiling point exceeding 190°C, its advanced formulation provides outstanding resistance to vapour lock and fluid-induced brake fade during repeated high-intensity braking. Its low-compressibility characteristics, superior thermal stability and advanced corrosion inhibition chemistry promote firm pedal response, consistent hydraulic pressure transmission and reliable braking performance under demanding motorsport conditions. Performance Specifications: FMVSS No. 116 DOT 4, ISO 4925 Class 4, SAE J1704

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Specially developed for high-performance hydraulic braking and clutch systems in race-ready, extensively modified and high-performance sports vehicles subjected to repeated severe braking and extreme thermal loads, where the highest level of glycol-based DOT 4 brake fluid specification is specified.

products.name: PRINCE® GT COOLING LIGHT BLUE RACING COOLANT
description: PRINCE® GT COOLING LIGHT BLUE RACING COOLANT is a high-performance, ultra-pure water-based racing coolant specifically formulated to maximize heat dissipation and thermal exchange efficiency under the most extreme motorsport conditions. Unlike conventional glycol-based antifreezes, its specially designed glycol-free formulation capitalizes on the superior thermal conductivity, high specific heat capacity and low viscosity of water to facilitate efficient coolant circulation and rapid heat transfer from critical engine components. Reinforced with a specialized additive package, its formulation is designed to safeguard aluminium radiators, cylinder heads, water pumps and other cooling system components against corrosion, scale and deposit formation, while maintaining consistent and dependable thermal management under sustained high-RPM operation and extreme engine loads.

notices.label: Important
notices.text: Do not dilute further. Not intended for applications requiring antifreeze protection or mandatory glycol-based coolants.

notices.label: CAUTION
notices.text: THIS PRODUCT OFFERS NO ANTIFREEZE PROTECTION.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Specifically developed for high-performance stock engines, aggressively tuned high-boost engines and purpose-built racing powertrains equipped with water-cooled systems requiring enhanced heat dissipation and superior thermal management. Suitable for conventional and upgraded aluminium cooling systems where glycol-free coolant is permitted and antifreeze protection is not required.
